Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sunshine. One day, she saw a big white rabbit hopping across the path. She stopped to watch the rabbit and felt happy.

Lily asked the rabbit, "Are you okay?"

The rabbit replied, "Yes, I am okay. I have a lot of berries."

Lily picked some and put them in her basket. Suddenly, she saw a sign that said, "Lily, do you recognize the white rabbit?"

The rabbit was curious and asked, "What does it mean?"

Lily thought for a moment and said, "It means the white rabbit is far away from us. It can't go anywhere."

The rabbit smiled and said, "That's right, Lily. Next time, I will show the white rabbit more to the rabbit." And they both smiled.

The little dog was sad because he wanted to play with his friends. He didn't know if they could play with him anymore. The little dog had been so sad and he didn't know what to do. 

Then an old man came by and saw the dog's sad face. He asked the little dog what was wrong and the little dog said he was feeling sad because it was all alone. The old man felt a bit better and he and the little dog ran off with the big dog together. 

The poor dog was no longer alone. He was happy that he could play with his friends and be together. From then on, the little dog was never sad again. He was happy, and they played together every day.
